toegepas.blok: Nie elke stasie brand steenkool nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: Kernkrag names the power produced; the heat comes from nuclear energy, which also matches the lesson's energie-not-krag rule (the station name Kernkragstasie stays).
toegepas.fout: 'kernkrag' uses krag where the thing the heat comes from is energy, the exact krag/energie slip the protected list warns against.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'kernenergie' is the precise term, keeps the claim the same, follows the lesson's energie-not-krag rule, and leaves the name Kernkragstasie intact.

toegepas.blok: Die pad van die stasie af na 'n huis
toegepas.voor: loop die elektrisiteit in groot dik drade weg
toegepas.na: loop die elektrisiteit deur groot, dik drade weg
toegepas.rede_vinder: Electricity runs 'deur' wires, as elsewhere in the lesson, and two equal adjectives take a comma under the AWS.
toegepas.fout: 'loop ... in groot dik drade weg' is a slightly odd preposition for current moving along wires, and the two coordinate adjectives lack the AWS comma.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'deur' says the same thing (the current travels along the wires), matches the lesson's own 'loop deur lang drade', and 'groot, dik' is correct AWS punctuation.

toegepas.voor: By jou lampie het ook twee drade geloop
toegepas.na: By jou lampie het daar ook twee drade geloop
toegepas.rede_vinder: An indefinite subject after a fronted adverbial reads more naturally with existential 'daar', as the lesson does elsewhere.
toegepas.fout: An indefinite subject after a fronted adverbial without existential 'daar' reads stiff.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'het daar ook twee drade geloop' is the natural Afrikaans construction, used elsewhere in the lesson, and the meaning does not change.

toegepas.na: net soos jou lampie se stroombaan
toegepas.rede_vinder: The word stroombaan has not appeared in the text before, so 'daardie' has no clear antecedent; tie it to the lamp just mentioned.
toegepas.fout: 'daardie stroombaan' has no antecedent in the text, because the word stroombaan has not appeared before.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Linking it to the lamp's circuit from the sentence before names the same circuit, so nothing new is added and the reader no longer stumbles.

toegepas.rede_vinder: A lamp or kettle does not 'stand still'; 'werk nie' says the same thing naturally for every appliance.
toegepas.fout: 'staan stil' fits a machine but not a lamp, kettle or radio, so it reads wooden here.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'werk daardie toestel nie' says the same thing naturally for every appliance the lesson names.

toegepas.voor: ver van hier af in 'n bron gelê
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Hier' has no clear point of reference in the sentence; 'ver weg' keeps the meaning without it.
toegepas.fout: 'van hier af' has no clear reference point in a sentence that opens 'By die meeste huise'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'ver weg' keeps the meaning (the energy lay far away in a source) without the vague 'hier'.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: ver genoeg terug en jy kom
laat_vaar_vorige.na: ver genoeg terug, en jy kom
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two complete sentences here (an imperative and 'jy kom ... uit'), so a comma goes before it.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The first clause is an imperative with no subject of its own and the sentence is one tight 'do this and you get that' unit, so the house comma rule does not require a comma.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: As a conjunction introducing a clause, standard written Afrikaans uses 'totdat' rather than 'tot'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'tot' is standard Afrikaans as a conjunction, so 'totdat' is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Wat die stasie met die steenkool doen
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: In written study text a thing (the machine) is referred to as 'dit', not the colloquial 'hom'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'hom' points unambiguously to the machine, whereas 'dit' could also point back to 'die stoom' in the same sentence.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Nie elke stasie brand steenkool nie
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: This is the first machine mentioned at the dam station, so the indefinite article fits, as in the block's last sentence and the glossary.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'die masjien' reads naturally as the turning machine the reader has already met, so the article swap is lateral.
